text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon decided to run in the Satsuki 
Sho. However, that path would be far from 
smooth—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: H-How was it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aptitude issues run deep; the moment she 
runs on turf, her pace noticeably dulls.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I guess it's no good after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Even while running, I can tell. That 
I'm... not giving it my all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There isn't much time until the Satsuki 
Sho. Should we keep training and gamble on 
a miraculous awakening, or perhaps...
choice_data_list:
We need a secret plan to turn it all 
around in one shot.

We need a secret plan to turn it all 
around in one shot, don't we.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A secret plan...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...! That's it, in that case...! I might 
have a special secret plan☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Whoa, whoa, whoa-oh~~♪ Yeah~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Suzuka-chan, Trainer too! Don't 
just space out... Yeaaah☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what... what do you mean? 
Falcon-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Aw, just call me Falco-senpai already☆ 
Suzuka-chan, you're as serious as always♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka. An Umamusume who has 
already made a massive name for herself on 
turf. She captivates spectators with her 
dynamic, runaway front-running style.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon's secret weapon seems to be 
Silence Suzuka, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... weren't you supposed to teach me 
'tips for running on turf' today...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right☆ Thank you so much for taking 
it onっ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco loves the way you run, Suzuka-chan. 
That's why I want you to teach me!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm really happy to hear that, but... then 
why karaoke...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Before we run, I thought I'd learn a thing 
or two from Suzuka-chan's singing, too! 
Teehee☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat...!? I-I could never sing, not 
me—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...!? Even Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this! L-O-V-E! LOVE 
Suzuka~☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ehhh~...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after spending some time at 
karaoke learning (?) Silence Suzuka's 
songs—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I never thought they'd make me 
sing six songs in a row...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha, thanks for singing along♪ My heart is 
just so full right now, fal-yeah☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...That's why, Falco is—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat...?! Isn't that Silence Suzuka over 
there?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right! Kyaa~, Suzuka~!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text:
It's Suzuka! The real deal! Whoa, she's 
even prettier in person than on screen...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I watched your last race! It was an 
incredible run, you looked so cool!

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to your next race 
too! Um, well, it's still quite cold, so 
please take good care of yourself...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Umm... thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, we're completely surrounded. 
Suzuka-chan really is so popular, isn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I can totally understand why. 
Suzuka-chan's running and singing are both 
so wonderful, after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thrilling, enchanting... I just love it so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I bet everyone else draws a ton of 
strength from Suzuka-chan too."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Falco wants to become like that too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka is probably very close to 
the ideal top Umadol that Smart Falcon 
aspires to be.
choice_data_list: You can do it too, Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, thank you! Falco believes so 
too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Just admiring someone from afar 
isn't going to cut it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I have to seize it with my own two feet!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hello to all of Suzuka-chan's fans out 
there~! Good day~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm the super spotlight Umadol, Falco☆ I'm 
gonna be running in the Satsuki Sho next♪

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan A
text_block_list.text: Falco...? Never heard of her, though...

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan B
text_block_list.text:
“She's running in the 『Satsuki Sho』, 
though. Does that mean she's strong... I 
wonder?”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That・is! Something you'll have to see 
with your own eyes☆ I'll be waiting at the 
racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is always doing street lives, so 
feel free to drop by and watch♪"

text_block_list.name: Suzuka Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"What an interesting girl. Guess I'll look 
into her a bit..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. An incredible person, as always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward. Back at the academy, Smart 
Falcon was to learn how to run from 
Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...! They're incredible after all. Falco's 
definitely gonna be like that too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired not only by the singing but also 
by that running form, a renewed passion 
for the Satsuki Sho took hold.
